top_violation_types.title: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child (26 TAC §746.3415(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A caregiver did not wash their hands after changing a child's diaper.

top_violation_types.title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §746.3417(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A child did not have their hands washed following a diaper change.

top_violation_types.title: Diapering Procedures - Sanitizing Diaper Changing Area (26 TAC §746.3505(e))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Diaper changes were observed at inspection and the diaper changing surface was not sanitized after any of the diaper changes.

top_violation_types.title: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - Driver or designated employee conduct walk-through and visual check of vehicle (26 TAC §746.5625(d)(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Based on the information obtained during the DFPS investigation, sufficient evidence was available to support the driver who transported a group of children failed to conduct a walk-through and/or a visual check to all children were unloaded before disabling the alarm system in the rear of the vehicle.

top_violation_types.title: Safety Precautions for Loading and Unloading Children - Account for All Children (26 TAC §746.5605(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Based upon the information gathered during the investigation, evidence was available to support safety precautions for loading and unloading children to ensure all children were accounted for was not followed.  As a result, a child was left on the van unattended.

top_violation_types.title: AP Safety Precautions for Loading and Unloading Children - No Child Unattended (26 TAC §746.5605(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: It was determined that a child in care was left unattended in a vehicle owned and operated by the operation.

top_violation_types.title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The grassy area on one of the operations playgrounds was found to have a deep step down with the sprinkler system being exposed.

top_violation_types.title: Posting of Activity Plan (26 TAC §746.2209)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Current activity plans were not posted in the classrooms.
